Table 8.1 shows some data relating to the properties of air, gel and body tissue. The data are given to three significant figures.

Table 8.1

| {{header}} material | {{header}} density / $\text{kg m}^{-3}$ | {{header}} speed of sound / $\text{m s}^{-1}$ | {{header}} specific acoustic impedance / $\text{kg m}^{-2}\text{s}^{-1}$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| air | {{answer}} | 340 | 440 |
| gel | 1200 | 1400 | {{answer}} |
| tissue | 1090 | {{answer}} | $1.68 \times 10^6$ |
parts.text: Show that the specific acoustic impedance of gel is $1.68 \times 10^6 \text{kg m}^{-2}\text{s}^{-1}$.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: Complete Table 8.1 by calculating the missing values to three significant figures. Use the space below for any working that you need.
